title: Fail closed on malformed legacy Skill contract lines
goal: Make the legacy Skill contract parser reject malformed and duplicate fields rather than silently dropping or overwriting ambiguous input.
context: LegacySkillDefinitionParser currently skips non-comment lines without a colon and overwrites duplicate keys. The public static SkillMarkdownParser.parse entry point delegates to it, so malformed or ambiguous imported contract text can be accepted silently.
forbidden_changes: Do not change the canonical Skill.md parser grammar or field names.
Do not silently normalize malformed or duplicate fields into a valid contract.
Do not modify executor mapping, policy, UI, or provider behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A non-empty non-comment line without a delimiter throws SkillDefinitionError.malformed.
Duplicate field keys throw SkillDefinitionError.malformed instead of last-write-wins.
Existing valid legacy Skill contracts continue to parse.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If valid legacy contracts fail, preserve the existing required-field semantics while rejecting only malformed lines and duplicate keys.
